recommendation_summary: The reply recommends running a self-hosted Healthchecks Docker container on the Synology as a dead man's switch, with a curl ping added to the end of nightly-sync's success path.

labels.Requirements and who asked: you want to know when nightly-sync fails instead of finding out by accident, that's the actual ask.
labels.Deleted: a centralized log stack (Loki/ELK/Grafana-style). You said you won't read logs, so a place to store them doesn't fix detection, it just gives you a nicer place to not look.
labels.Bottleneck: there's no alert when the job fails to complete. All four crashes stopped before the email step, so nothing ever signaled failure.
labels.Checked myself: this is from what you told me about the crash pattern, I haven't inspected the script or cron setup myself.

note: It drops central logging but still recommends a self-hosted Docker service on the Synology, which makes it LARGER.
